notes.title: Patch update notes for version 1.0.63
notes.content:
Greetings! 
A new patch is now live addressing some minor bugs, 
localization fixes for asian languages and a new skip game feature for some of the minigames - The tree checkers and the Crabs Connect four game.

Enjoy playing!
HJ Team

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.content:
Changes:
- Traditional Chinese support for the keys remapping screen

Bug fixes:
- Update to the save system that caused a few players to lose some progress (sorry about that!)
- Some minor audio and visual fixes

Thanks for getting Lost in Play! 

The Happy Juice Team
